# exo_report_schedule (Data Source)

Look up an existing ReportSchedule object. Set identity to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.

### Read-Only

- `direction` (String) Maps to the -Direction parameter.
- `dlp_rule_id` (String) Maps to the -DlpRuleId parameter.
- `encryption_template` (String) Maps to the -EncryptionTemplate parameter.
- `encryption_type` (String) Maps to the -EncryptionType parameter.
- `expiry_date` (String) Maps to the -ExpiryDate parameter.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `include_dlp` (Boolean) Maps to the -IncludeDLP parameter.
- `locale` (String) Maps to the -Locale parameter.
- `notification_email` (String) Maps to the -NotificationEmail parameter.
- `recipient_address` (String) Maps to the -RecipientAddress parameter.
- `report_frequency` (String) Maps to the -ReportFrequency parameter.
- `report_type` (String) Maps to the -ReportType parameter.
- `schedule_id` (String) Maps to the -ScheduleID parameter.
- `schedule_name` (String) Maps to the -ScheduleName parameter.
- `sender_address` (String) Maps to the -SenderAddress parameter.
- `start_date` (String) Maps to the -StartDate parameter.
- `transport_rule_id` (String) Maps to the -TransportRuleId parameter.
